<div class="prism-block-header">
<span class="section-header prism-block-title adv-heading">Market Prism</span>
{% if market_prism_summary %}
{# Sentiment verdict: a dot and one word. Maps overall_sentiment to its semantic CSS modifier.
Both canonical (risk-on/risk-off) and synonym (bullish/bearish) forms are emitted by the
lens_pipeline synthesizer; both sets must map. #}
{% set _chip_class = {
'bullish':        'prism-sentiment-chip--risk-on',
'risk-on':        'prism-sentiment-chip--risk-on',
'bearish':        'prism-sentiment-chip--risk-off',
'risk-off':       'prism-sentiment-chip--risk-off',
'neutral':        'prism-sentiment-chip--neutral',
'limited-inputs': 'prism-sentiment-chip--limited-inputs',
}.get(_sentiment, 'prism-sentiment-chip--neutral') %}
<span class="prism-sentiment-chip {{ _chip_class }}"

<span class="prism-as-of" data-testid="prism-as-of">As of {{ _created | et_stamp }}</span>

<div class="prism-intro">
<p class="adv-explainer" data-explainer="O15">An overnight read of the market through five lenses: technicals, sentiment, derivatives, macro and fundamentals. It is background for your decisions and changes nothing by itself.</p>
<details class="hp-more" data-terms="O15">
<summary>What the terms mean</summary>
<p data-term="O16">risk-on: conditions favor taking risk. risk-off: they favor caution. neutral: no lean either way. limited-inputs: too few lenses had data for a read.</p>
<p data-term="O19">Lenses: technicals reads price trends and breadth, sentiment reads news tone, derivatives reads volatility measures, macro reads rates, inflation and jobs data, and fundamentals reads company filings.</p>
<p data-term="O24">Numeric verification: each number the read lists as a cited figure is checked against lens data fetched after the read; verified means it matched, and unverifiable means there was nothing to check it against, not that it is wrong. Numbers that appear only in the prose are not checked.</p>
</details>
</div>{# /prism-intro #}

{# Per-lens source carousels — one carousel per non-empty lens in canonical
order.  A URL that is cited under multiple lenses appears in each of
those lens carousels.  Plain string citations (sources list) render as
citation cards; article_corpus entries with a valid http(s) URL render
as clickable anchor cards.  Lenses with zero sources are suppressed.
XSS-safe: all values escaped with | e, no | safe used. #}
{% set _ns = namespace(any_sources=false) %}
{% for _lname in _lens_names %}
{% set _le = _per_lens.get(_lname, {}) %}
{% if _le.get('sources') or _le.get('article_corpus') %}
{% set _ns.any_sources = true %}
{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
{% set _src_n = namespace(total=0) %}
{% for _lname in _lens_names %}
{% set _le = _per_lens.get(_lname, {}) %}
{% set _src_n.total = _src_n.total + (_le.get('article_corpus', []) | length) + (_le.get('sources', []) | length) %}
{% endfor %}
{% if _ns.any_sources %}
<details class="prism-sources" data-testid="prism-sources">
<summary>Sources ({{ _src_n.total }})</summary>
{% for _lname in _lens_names %}
{% set _le = _per_lens.get(_lname, {}) %}
{% set _le_articles = _le.get('article_corpus', []) %}
{% set _le_sources  = _le.get('sources', []) %}
{% if _le_articles or _le_sources %}
<div data-testid="prism-sources-lens-{{ _lname }}">
<div class="prism-lens-carousel-label">{{ _lname | capitalize }}</div>
<div class="prism-sources-carousel">
{% for _art in _le_articles %}
{% if _art.get('url') and _art.get('url').startswith(('http://', 'https://')) %}
<a class="prism-source-card"
href="{{ _art.get('url') | e }}"
target="_blank"
rel="noopener noreferrer">
<span>{{ _art.get('title', 'Untitled') | e }}</span>
{% if _art.get('published') %}
<span class="prism-source-meta">{{ _art.get('published') | et_stamp(naive_is_utc=False) }}</span>
{% endif %}
</a>
{% else %}
<div class="prism-source-card prism-source-card--citation">
<span>{{ _art.get('title', '') | e }}</span>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
{% for _src_str in _le_sources %}
<div class="prism-source-card prism-source-card--citation">
<span>{{ _src_str | e }}</span>
</div>
{% endfor %}
</div>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
</details>
{% endif %}
{# Numeric verification overlay (DE-PRISM-NUMERIC-VERIFY-001, AC-10).
2026-07 redesign: the day-to-day signal is the VERDICT, not 27
individual passes — default render is one verdict pill + a
short count line; only flagged/overridden checks (the actionable
anti-fabrication catches) render as individual badges, with a
collapsed "show all" disclosure for full transparency.
Honest empty-state: renders nothing when no VERIFICATION row
exists yet for this run_id (no fabricated badges).
XSS-safe: all values escaped with | e, no | safe used. #}
{# /review PR #92: one macro renders a single check badge (indicator
+ classification + optional annotation) — shared by the top-level
actionable list and the <details> full list below, instead of two
near-identical inline loops differing only by testid prefix. #}
{% macro render_verify_check(chk, testid_prefix, show_annotation_testid=false) %}
{# .get(key, default)'s default only fires when the key is
ABSENT, not when it's present with value None (F1, /review
PR #90). indicator can be None (Finding-1's `{}`-coercion
path for a malformed cited_numbers entry); classification
cannot be None from the real _build_check/_classify producer
chain (always one of pass/flagged/overridden/unverifiable) —
this guard is defense-in-depth only, against a hand-authored
or legacy DB row bypassing the normal write path. #}
{% set _cls = chk.get('classification') or 'unverifiable' %}
{% set _indicator = chk.get('indicator') or '' %}
{% set _badge_class = {
'pass':         'prism-verify-badge--pass',
'flagged':      'prism-verify-badge--flagged',
'overridden':   'prism-verify-badge--overridden',
'unverifiable': 'prism-verify-badge--unverifiable',
}.get(_cls, 'prism-verify-badge--unverifiable') %}
<div class="prism-verify-check"
data-testid="{{ testid_prefix }}{{ _indicator | e }}">
<span class="prism-verify-badge {{ _badge_class }}">
{{ _indicator | e }} — {{ _cls | e }}
</span>
{% if chk.get('annotation') %}
<p class="prism-verify-annotation"
{% if show_annotation_testid %}data-testid="prism-verify-annotation"{% endif %}>{{ chk.get('annotation') | e }}</p>
{% endif %}
</div>
{% endmacro %}
{% if market_prism_verification is not none %}
<div data-testid="prism-verification" class="prism-verification">
<div class="prism-verification-header">Numeric verification</div>
{# verdict_label/verdict_class computed in ai_advisor_tab()
(single source of truth — /review PR #92): the pill
reuses the 4 existing check-badge classes, and an
unknown/missing verdict renders a neutral pill labeled
with the raw string (or "unknown") rather than
defaulting to the specific "no-numeric-claims" claim. #}
<div class="prism-verify-summary" data-testid="prism-verify-summary">
<span class="prism-verify-badge {{ market_prism_verification.get('verdict_class', 'prism-verify-badge--unverifiable') }}"
data-testid="prism-verify-verdict">{{ market_prism_verification.get('verdict_label', 'unknown') | e }}</span>
{% if market_prism_verification.get('count_line') %}
<span class="prism-verify-summary-count"
data-testid="prism-verify-count-line">{{ market_prism_verification.get('count_line') | e }}</span>
{% endif %}
</div>
{# Only the actionable catches (flagged/overridden) render as
individual badges by default — pass/unverifiable stay folded
into the count line above. #}
{% for _chk in market_prism_verification.get('actionable_checks', []) %}
{{ render_verify_check(_chk, 'prism-verify-check-', show_annotation_testid=true) }}
{% endfor %}
{% if market_prism_verification.get('checks') %}
<details class="prism-verify-details" data-testid="prism-verify-details">
<summary>Show all {{ market_prism_verification.get('checks') | length }} checks</summary>
<div class="prism-verify-details-list">
{% for _chk in market_prism_verification.get('checks', []) %}
{{ render_verify_check(_chk, 'prism-verify-check-full-') }}
{% endfor %}
</div>
</details>
{% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}
